versions.changelog:
Initial release of the churn-analysis skill.

- Generates structured churn analysis reports that clearly separate avoidable from unavoidable churn.
- Calculates and benchmarks customer and revenue churn, net revenue retention (NRR), and segment breakdowns.
- Classifies churn reasons, prioritises interventions, and provides actionable recommendations with estimated impact.
- Identifies early warning signals and churn timing patterns to support proactive retention.
- Includes a scoring rubric and anti-patterns checklist to ensure output quality and actionable insights.
